import json
from langfuse import observe
from langfuse._client.attributes import LangfuseOtelSpanAttributes


def _finished_spans_by_name(memory_exporter, name):
    return [span for span in memory_exporter.get_finished_spans() if span.name == name]


def test_error_output_captured_by_default(langfuse_memory_client, memory_exporter):
    @observe(name="error_default")
    def will_error():
        raise ValueError("bad things")

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        will_error()

    langfuse_memory_client.flush()
    span = _finished_spans_by_name(memory_exporter, "error_default")[0]
    attrs = span.attributes
    # The observation output should contain the error message when default flag is True
    assert LangfuseOtelSpanAttributes.OBSERVATION_OUTPUT in attrs
    output = json.loads(attrs[LangfuseOtelSpanAttributes.OBSERVATION_OUTPUT])
    assert output == {"error": "bad things"}


def test_error_output_not_captured_when_flag_disabled(langfuse_memory_client, memory_exporter):

    # No observation output should be recorded when capture_error_output=False
    assert LangfuseOtelSpanAttributes.OBSERVATION_OUTPUT not in attrs"
}
